programme.title: BATTLE OF MARRIAGE

programme.title: HIDDEN LOVE

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)

programme.title: THE FADING GOLD
programme.desc: Peguam Hualong yakin memenangi kes berbekalkan laporan perubatan Yangtian. Konflik makin memuncak apabila Lin Yao menculik Jasmine untuk memeras ugut Shan Quan, memaksa Lin Cheng bertindak melindungi Shan Quan.

programme.title: MY STAR FAMILY

programme.title: THE PROMISE

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts & Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Wudang Martial Arts & Taichi
programme.desc: Join host Yegor on a journey into the heart of China’s Wudang Mountains—the spiritual cradle of Taoism and the birthplace of Wudang martial arts. Through in-depth conversations with renowned masters such as Zhong Xueyong, Cai Chongguang, Jake Pinnick, and Liu Xiang, this episode explores the philosophy, techniques, and living spirit of Wudang Quan and Taichi. From the internal cultivation of qi to the harmony between body and mind, Wudang martial arts are more than just physical training—they are a way of life rooted in the Tao. Alongside martial techniques, the program also delves into traditional Chinese music, calligraphy, and medicine, revealing how these disciplines come together in the pursuit of balance, self-awareness, and longevity. This is not just a story of punches and postures, but of tradition, transformation, and the timeless search for harmony between humans and the universe.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: Face-changing wonder boy
programme.desc: Face-changing is an ancient Chinese performance art that is a component of Sichuan opera. Hu Yibo, 13, learned the act from his grandfather and other experienced masters. Dressed in brightly-colored costumes and while changing from one mask to another in just the blink of an eye, Yibo skillfully swipes open a fan to hide his "magical" movements. As a young inheritor, he undertakes daily training to perfect his skill set in the hope of becoming a master one day.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Taste of Home
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May eat their way down memory lane across virtual space and different time zones, and embark on a culinary journey at their birthplace. Eva rediscovers her love for a classic century-old dish in her hometown Vienna and introduces Austria's long-lasting coffeehouse culture to Tianran, who also joins her virtually for an evening with friends and food the traditional Viennese way. Meanwhile, Beijing's charming autumn season sets Tianran back in time as he rediscovers flavors from his childhood. His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

His passion for tea might have even started in one of the old tea shops in Beijing's hutongs, recollecting his memories one sip at a time, accompanied by nostalgic meals and a relaxed stroll under yellow gingko trees.

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along the Taihu Lake. All these phenomena demonstrate that economic development and environmental protection can achieve harmonious coexistence, and that civilization thrives if ecology is prosperous.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: "When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life."

The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life."

programme.title: Ad Break
programme.desc: Ad Break

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He travels to Shannan, the cradle of Tibetan culture. Nestled in the gentlest valley of the Yarlung Zangbo River, this is where the first Tibetan king rose to power, the first palace in Xizang was built, and many other “firsts” in Xizang’s history began. Tianran visits Yamdrok Lake, one of Xizang’s three sacred lakes, where a paragliding base is taking shape. He then learns the art of Tibetan opera, joins rangers on a mission to track the elusive Tibetan red deer, and ends the day with a rejuvenating soak in a village revitalized by hot spring tourism.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history. Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode shows how true inner strength is like traditional timber architecture: stable, balanced, and built from within.

programme.title: Foodwise: Haikou

programme.title: Foodwise: Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. The reason that people tend to visit Hianan not only because of the beautiful beach view but also delicious local cuisine in Hainan. Hainan’s four famous dishes is Chicken, duck, goat and crab. In Wenchang, the ancestral home of many overseas Chinese, people could discover the original version of Hainan Chicken Rice and see how local chickens free range on coconut meat. In Qionghai, seat of the Boao Forum for Asia, you may dine on duck and goat, before feasting on crab in the surfer haven of Wanning.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.desc: The three boys have come to us by riding the moon! BDC is coming to ASC with their new album [THE INTERSECTION : DISCOVERY]. Far apart, but together in heart! We’ve got a lot of prizes ready for those who participate on After School Club, so if you want to make some special memories, don’t hesitate!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for LEEBADA x I’m LIVE by LEEBADA
[TV’s on] The pad and guitar together create a sound that evokes feelings of being in a dark room [ FLOWER] Please enjoy the mellow R&B harmonies creating a dreamy sound [Diving] This is my musical expression of ocean waves rolling into shore. Please close your eyes and savor every bit [Blue rose] This is how I imagine dawn with various shades of blue [Believe what you want] This is my musical portrait that I wrote in 2018, inspired by the sadness of loss and betrayal. The protagonist tells people to believe what they want to believe with restrained emotions.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for An Shin-ae x I’m LIVE by An Shin-ae
[Hold Me Now] This song was written when I was going through possibly the toughest time of my life. When you need something to lean on, this is what I'd like to offer – An Shin-ae [Inefficient Love] Love is awfully inefficient, especially in the city where efficiency is everything. However, where there is life, there is love. Please enjoy how love enriches our lives through the song’s progression. [Dear City] This song features the sounds of Jeju’s Gotjawal Forest. Nature encompasses everything, so let’s immerse in its beauty for a few minutes. [Soul] This is a new arrangement of “Soul,” produced by my friend cloud koh. Our synergy and harmony will present a prime example of soul music [Respect] This is my debut song with a message that everyone should be respected. I hope it reminds you of what you deserve

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is sunwoojunga! [JAZZ BOX] Everything is possible in the name of jazz! Please enjoy the endless rhythmic changes and unique sounds [What the hell] Enough is enough! Stop wasting your time and energy on those who aren’t worth it [STAR CANDY] Let’s swallow up this intense dance song! [Youth, for a while] It’s my diary I wrote during my young and fragile youth [Shimmer] From slow to explosive, please listen for the cathartic flow of energy!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for YdBB x I’m LIVE by YdBB
[ONCE] This is our message to those we cherish most. We will always be together like today and forever [RUNAWAY] Let’s forget all our worries and run away! [ Voyage] Full of refreshing sounds, this is a quintessential summer song [LETTER] It’s our debut song! Please sing along to the outro with usB [Today is the day] Today is the day when your dreams can come true!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for LEEBADA x I’m LIVE by LEEBADA
[TV’s on] The pad and guitar together create a sound that evokes feelings of being in a dark room [ FLOWER] Please enjoy the mellow R&B harmonies creating a dreamy sound [Diving] This is my musical expression of ocean waves rolling into shore. Please close your eyes and savor every bit [Blue rose] This is how I imagine dawn with various shades of blue [Believe what you want] This is my musical portrait that I wrote in 2018, inspired by the sadness of loss and betrayal. The protagonist tells people to believe what they want to believe with restrained emotions.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for An Shin-ae x I’m LIVE by An Shin-ae
[Hold Me Now] This song was written when I was going through possibly the toughest time of my life. When you need something to lean on, this is what I'd like to offer – An Shin-ae [Inefficient Love] Love is awfully inefficient, especially in the city where efficiency is everything. However, where there is life, there is love. Please enjoy how love enriches our lives through the song’s progression. [Dear City] This song features the sounds of Jeju’s Gotjawal Forest. Nature encompasses everything, so let’s immerse in its beauty for a few minutes. [Soul] This is a new arrangement of “Soul,” produced by my friend cloud koh. Our synergy and harmony will present a prime example of soul music [Respect] This is my debut song with a message that everyone should be respected. I hope it reminds you of what you deserve

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is sunwoojunga! [JAZZ BOX] Everything is possible in the name of jazz! Please enjoy the endless rhythmic changes and unique sounds [What the hell] Enough is enough! Stop wasting your time and energy on those who aren’t worth it [STAR CANDY] Let’s swallow up this intense dance song! [Youth, for a while] It’s my diary I wrote during my young and fragile youth [Shimmer] From slow to explosive, please listen for the cathartic flow of energy!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc:
Instruction Manual for YdBB x I’m LIVE by YdBB
[ONCE] This is our message to those we cherish most. We will always be together like today and forever [RUNAWAY] Let’s forget all our worries and run away! [ Voyage] Full of refreshing sounds, this is a quintessential summer song [LETTER] It’s our debut song! Please sing along to the outro with usB [Today is the day] Today is the day when your dreams can come true!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - FROM ALL TO HUMAN
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the R&B quintet FROM ALL TO HUMAN! Composed of vocalist Blesssing guitarist PARK JAE WOO bassist NAM WOO SEOK keyboardist MOON SUNG HWAN and drummer MOON SEONG HO this band brought a new wave of R&B to the Korean music scene upon their debut in 2017. With their band's name referring to a journey “from all beings to humans” the five hope to develop every day as musicians. True to their name they are evolving and developing every day winning the Grand Prize at the 2019 Shinhan Card Rookie Project and the TOP2 at KT&G’s SangSang Madang Band Discovery Competition in 2019. From acid jazz to R&B to new jack swing the quintet covers a wide range of genres in their music backed up by solid storylines which makes them truly one of a kind. In this episode FROM ALL TO HUMAN performs Dizzy Oriental chill Don't be disappointed and more to showcase the quintessence of their musicality. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these five genuine musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - ADOY
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the city pop band ADOY! Composed of vocalist and guitarist Oh Juhwan keyboardist Zee bassist Jung Dayoung and drummer Park Geunchang this quartet burst onto the music scene in 2017 with the EP CATNIP. Thanks to the success of Grace and San Francisco from the EP they topped the K-Indie Chart and became nominated for Best Modern Rock at the prestigious Korean Music Awards in 2018. Then in the following year they won Judges' Prize at the Seoul Music Awards creating a new flow of Korean city pop. ADOY's music has a special power. Iit fills the city with romantic vibes instantly and also transforms city noises into sophisticated tunes. What's more their music has mass appeal yet it is unique. So now the quartet itself is a genre that mesmerizes not only Korean listeners but also the world. Last month ADOY released their new EP her to display their ever-evolving artistry and the quartet is here to perform their latest tracks including Simply Antihero Baby and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet ADOY!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Kim Jae-hyung
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kim Jae-hyung! Kim Jae-hyung is a self-taught guitarist who picked up the guitar when he was serving in the NAVY as a secretary for the naval military band. He continued playing the instrument after his discharge and had the first public performance in 2013 at an unplugged open mic night. Then in 2017 he released his first EP CIRCUS. Three years later he presented his first full-length album Flex which was nominated for Best Folk Album at the 2021 Korean Music Awards and the lead single Failure Story was nominated for Best Folk Song. Kim Jae-hyung is also known for covering a wide spectrum of music. Recently he came up with a new single titled Addiction with danceable vibes. Constantly pushing his musical boundaries this artist definitely makes us look forward to his future moves. In this episode Kim Jae-hyung performs Addiction Failure Story More Doubt and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - J_ust
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - YESEO
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is electronic musician and producer YESEO! This artist burst into the music scene in 2016 with her first single Let It All Go. Two years later in 2018 she was nominated for Best Rookie Best Dance & Electronic Album Best Dance & Electronic Song at the 15th Korean Music Awards with her first EP Million Things. This talented musician mesmerized not only domestic listeners but those outside Korea. The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. In this episode YESEO performs Privacy HOT HAND Cigarette Light as well as Youthful Kids and Free Up from her latest EP TRY TREE! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - YEGNY
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter YEGNY formerly known as Choi Ye-geun! This artist first became known in 2012 as the genius keyboardist in an audition program titled K-pop Star - Season 2. Since then she has actively pursued her career as a musician releasing a number of singles and working with other top-notch musicians including AKMU. Last year YEGNY released her first full-length album Even If Get Lost It Can Flow Anyway and shared with the public her concerns as a musician and self-reflection as well as her view on human relationships and social issues. With the song Better Rush (feat. Huckleberry P) she changed her stage name to YEGNY to mark a new beginning as an artist. In this episode YEGNY performs Better Rush I know Lucid dream and Unbalance as well as her cover of Better by BoA and Irony by Wonder Girls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out all that YEGNY has to show off!

programme.title: Santai 612
programme.desc: Pengisian slot: Nasihatul Tasnim merangkumi perkongsian ilmu Tauhid yang menyentuh aspek keimanan dan kehidupan seharian. Slot ini turut diserikan dengan segmen Muzik Ekspress – Rima yang menampilkan siaran lagu-lagu Irama Melayu pilihan. Seterusnya, BBMU (Bingkisan Buat Mu) membawakan dedikasi khas kepada pendengar, di samping penyampaian ucapan yang diterima melalui Facebook dan WhatsApp. Slot ini juga memuatkan hebahan terkini sebelum diakhiri dengan penutup yang ringkas dan bermakna.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt and the keepers at Flamingoland come up with a cunning plan as they face the difficult task of trying to move a three and a half ton white rhino to Sweden. On a much smaller scale, an abandoned rabbit with an urgent dental problem and Matt discovers that picking up a penguin isn't as easy as it sounds.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Comedian Alan Davies is acting vet's assistant at Harmsworth animal hospital in London. He's helping out with a case of two Staffordshire Bull Terrier sisters who have had a major falling out. With fur flying, one has ended up with nasty wounds to her neck and mouth. Alan helps vet Sam to access and treat the injuries and also learns how to keep your pets from fighting.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: Lagu Negaraku
programme.desc: Negaraku is the national anthem of Malaysia, symbolising the nation’s sovereignty, unity, and patriotism.

programme.title: GLOBAL - ON THE TABLE
programme.desc: In this latest episode of On The Table, the discussion explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the future of work and transforming modern workplaces. The programme looks at the changing nature of jobs, evolving workplace skills, and how organisations and employees can adapt to an increasingly AI-driven working environment.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: 深夜留声机
programme.desc: 周靖与旗何为你精选慢节凑、温暖氛围的音乐（爵士、Lo-Fi、轻民谣），穿插分享正能量语录及鼓励的话，用声音营造安全感，让凌晨变得温柔。

programme.title: 晨光微旅
programme.desc: 励志或晨间小故事，轻快音乐逐步提速，让听众从困倦过渡到清醒。

programme.title: 早安 老时光
programme.desc: 每天 5点到6点，为您送上60-80 经典老歌，让你听出耳油！

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 说一惠儿
programme.desc: 生活太忙，话题太重？不如停下脚步，和淑惠一起“说一会儿”。这里是《Talk with Hui 说一惠儿》，一个没有说教、不设门槛的声音客厅。每期节目，主播惠都会邀请有趣的朋友做客，或是独自坐下，聊聊日常里的奇思妙想、职场上的酸甜苦辣，以及那些打动内心的瞬间。一杯茶，麦克风前，我们今天就轻松地“说一惠儿”！

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horrors haunt each family from within, and nothing is really as it seems.

programme.title: Fengmen Village Horror
programme.desc: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

programme.title: Chapter 1 Mae Nak Reborn
programme.desc: Mae Nak the ghost wife returns to take revenge for a pregnant woman who is sexually assaulted and loses her baby. No one can identify the assailant except Mae Nak, who turns into an evil spirit in order to punish the assailant for his evil deeds.

Sebenarnya Markus tidak akan melakukannya. Markus menggunakan tempoh masa itu untuk lagakan Ain dan Tauke Lim. Bila kedua-dua ini hancur maka Markus akan bangunkan semula syarikat kopinya sendiri.

Mereka dibesarkan oleh Pak Su yang merupakan seorang penghibur jalanan. Seeman bercita-cita menjadi seorang Doktor, namun impian itu tidak tercapai. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
